articles.title: Defence Ministry clears ₹2.12 lakh crore military acquisitions, including 200 helicopters
articles.summary: The Indian armed forces are poised for a significant upgrade, with plans to acquire additional mobile artillery guns, a new fleet of light and VVIP transport helicopters, destroyers, and advanced drone systems. This major procurement drive, initiated in New Delhi, aims to enhance India's defence capabilities across land, air, and sea, ensuring modernization and operational readiness.

articles.title: FIR against 2 for molesting Dalit woman
articles.summary: China recently lectured India on maintaining border peace. This admonition followed reports of the People's Liberation Army (PLA) deviating from established patrol routes within India's Arunachal Pradesh. Such incidents underscore persistent tensions and the critical need for vigilance along the Line of Actual Control (LAC), an area of paramount importance for India's defence strategy and national security.
